overall_assessment: Ordinary OsloMet subject courses (random controls) split well: all five-six canonical sections are present and correct, including arbeidskrav correctly kept out of assessment and Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse kept inside learning_outcomes. All 20 suspects are the Praksis (M1GP/M5GP) courses, where every section is the placeholder 'Se fagplanen.' and the real fagplan content is lost; this is a real, systematic failure for that course family.

findings.evidence: Se fagplanen. Se fagplanen. Se fagplanen.
findings.description: All 20 suspect courses (every Praksis course, M1GP*/M5GP*, all years) emit prerequisites, learning_outcomes, course_content, teaching_methods and coursework_requirements each as the 13-char placeholder 'Se fagplanen.', and assessment as that placeholder three times. The pre-pass flags (empty, boilerplate) are real, not false alarms. No canonical section carries real content although the plan has a long Fagplan body.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The OsloMet emneplan page contains per-section stubs 'Se fagplanen.' and the html_headings strategy (h2) only reads those stubs; the actual Fagplan body is not mapped to sections.
findings.suggested_fix: In extract_sections for oslomet, detect sections whose text is just 'Se fagplanen.'/'Se under ... i fagplanen.' and drop them; for Praksis courses, segment the Fagplan body by its own headings (Organisering og arbeidsmåter -> teaching_methods, Vurdering -> assessment) in R/section_heading_map.R.

findings.evidence: Vurdering i praksisopplæringen skal bidra til læring og utvikling hos studentene.
findings.description: The plan has real content under 'Vurdering' (mid-term assessment, final assessment by praksislærer) and 'Organisering og arbeidsmåter' (Observasjon, Undervisning, Veiledning), which map to assessment and teaching_methods, yet none of it is extracted; only placeholder text is emitted. Same root cause as the placeholder finding but the loss is of genuine section content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Fagplan sub-headings in the Praksis plans are not recognised as section headings (missing patterns in R/section_heading_map.R, or the fagplan container is outside the selected h2 scope).
findings.suggested_fix: Add heading patterns for 'Organisering og arbeidsmåter' (teaching_methods) and 'Vurdering' (assessment) and ensure the Fagplan body is included in the heading walk for Praksis courses.

findings.description: The identical placeholder is repeated across five sections, and three times concatenated within assessment (43 chars), i.e. duplicated content across and within rows.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Multiple headings (e.g. Vurdering/Eksamen sub-blocks) map to assessment and their stub text is concatenated.
findings.suggested_fix: Filter stub-only sections in .clean_sections() (drop text matching ^Se (under .*)?fagplanen\.?$) before emitting rows.

findings.description: Regular courses sometimes emit pointer sentences as section text (prerequisites 'Se under Opptakskrav i fagplanen.'; teaching_methods 'Sjå i fagplanen om arbeids- og undervisningsformer i norskfaget.'; assessment 'Se under Vurdering/eksamen.'). They carry no content and are placeholders yet emitted as rows or left inside otherwise real text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No stub filter in .clean_sections() for cross-reference sentences.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop sections that consist only of a 'Se ...' cross-reference; strip such lines from otherwise real sections.

findings.evidence: har kunnskap om kjennetegn pa¿ et mangfoldig og inkluderende læringsmiljø
findings.description: Mojibake: 'å' appears as 'a¿' (also 'ma¿ter', 'tra¿d') in older/music course texts, corrupting words. Stray ';' also appears mid-sentence in nynorsk courses (e.g. 'Sjå;nærare retningslinjer').
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Source HTML encoding/combining-character problem or inline-element boundary handling in text extraction, upstream of section splitting.
findings.suggested_fix: Normalise 'a¿' -> 'å' (and similar) in text cleanup and convert inline-element boundaries to spaces instead of ';'.
